title: Scientist read-only reasoning and guarded Python analysis
purpose: Build read-only project evidence, perform bounded LLM reasoning/optional guarded analysis, and return advisory output without governance mutation.
entry_condition: Scientist Chat or Factory advisory path is invoked with available evidence/settings.
authority: Scientist may recommend; deterministic model/research/governance code decides admissibility and outcome.

transitions.action: Verify/read sealed evidence and construct bounded context
Parse explicit bounded analysis request when needed
Run capability-allowlisted child analysis and return evidence

invariants: No Factory/control/promotion authority is exposed to Scientist Python.
Scientist proposal outside effective legal/resource/scientific bounds is rejected.
Protected locked/fresh evidence cannot become tuning context.
LLM JSON recovery is bounded and cannot semantically rewrite deterministic authority.
failure_behavior: Provider/analysis failure falls back or fails closed according to call contract; it cannot mutate deterministic Factory authority.
restart_behavior: Chat thread/job reconciliation is idempotent and stale thread results are isolated.
rollback_behavior: No advisory failure changes release/Champion state.
